answer: Catch sybils at the cash register, not the door. Every farm's identities look independent until rewards move: follow the flow and each reward pulse drains to the same vertex — one sink collecting the herd. Compute a concentration index on where earnings land; when many identities funnel income to one destination, haircut their emission and refuse payment for their self-dealing attestations. Evasion means scattering funds across wallets and leaving them parked, so the operation turns glacier-slow and illiquid — laundering costs more than the emission is worth, and the farm defeats itself.
